name: Kokonoe (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kokonoe town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device, like a torii.
history: Municipal flag of Kokonoe, a town in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 1960.

features.role: Kokonoe town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device, like a torii
